findings.title: A failed item resume can mark every remaining item `not_run`
findings.description: Description: `_execute_each_step` passes a one-item list to `_finish_each_report` during item resume, but the `ItemRerun` carries the full report. If a `GitEnvironmentError` occurs while rerunning that item, `_finish_each_report` appends `not_run` records for items after position 0 using that one-item list—which is empty—and `_add_record` only replaces the resumed item. This avoids adding new records, but the resumed item is replaced with a generic step-failed record and loses its prior decision context; more importantly, the report write and halt behavior should preserve the loaded batch’s other records. Add a regression test for a mid-item git halt and verify all untouched records remain unchanged.

findings.title: Missing `completed` or `total` fields break task listing
findings.description: Description: `list_tasks` now requires both fields with `e["completed"]` and `e["total"]`. Any existing or older Context Forge response without either key raises `KeyError`, breaking task listing for callers including other pipelines. Confirm the CLI’s actual response contract or handle absent fields explicitly with validation and an observable error; current tests only cover responses that include both fields.
